question: Which of the following is an essential element used in the synthesis of proteins in plants?
solution:
the correct answer is __**Nitrogen.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Protein synthesis** accounts for a major part of the** energy** required for** plant growth.**

 
 
• **Amino acids** include **nitrogen**, which is a necessary component. All amino acids carry nitrogen in the amino group bonded to the α-carbon atom. Therefore, the name amino acids.** Proteins** are biopolymers of amino acids.
 
• In the absence of** nitrogen**, protein synthesis is impossible.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Calcium**

 
 
• Calcium (Ca) is essential for the **formation of plant tissues** and for the** improvement of plant growth.**
 
• It is responsible for** holding plant cell walls together.**
 
• It's also important for **activating enzymes** and **sending signals** that **coordinate cellular functions.**
 
 
 
• **​Sodium**
 
 
• Sodium is not an essential element for plants but can be used in small quantities, similar to **micronutrients**, to aid in the **metabolism **and **synthesis of chlorophyll**.
 
 
 
• **​Chlorine**
 
 
• ​Chlorine is crucial for** plant photosynthesis** as it is involved in the opening and closing of** stomata **(pores in leaves that enable plants to take in and release carbon dioxide, oxygen, and other gases as required).
 
• It also helps** ensure leaves are firm.**
 
 

5a:T
